the reference circuit after the deterministic polish passes.

LSH recoder (cx, cx, rccx per site) with the class bit taken from the raw l_nv parity: vp_0 <- vp_0^nv_1^nv_2^nv_3 = w_0^p (+2 CX per side) and site 0's Toffoli on (not f_3, f_0), which replaces the A=[u=v=0] rccx pair of the spin-network core; one flag a=[y0=y2=0]; 17-toggle walk on (w0, w0^p, a, y1, y3) ending on w0 (merged into the inverse collapse); 73 CX, 16 rotations, all angles k*beta/4 or 3*alpha/4.

swap-diagonal frame on site 1 (cx, cx, ch: its nv/vp swap becomes a CZ, no AND) with real-phase Margolus recoding on sites 0, 2, 3; collapse to one moving qubit, flags a1=[y0=y2=0] and A=[u=v=0] in separate ancillas, and a 14-term angle-linear walk (MILP optimum over w0, A, y0, a1, nv1, y3, w1) whose target sign carries the CZ(w1, nv1) of the swap-diagonal site.

native 3-AND frame (raw l_nv parity folded into site 0, Margolus Toffolis on sites 1-3, f-collapse) puts the bright move on f_0; an ungated 17-term Walsh multiplexer (30 CX) over invariant data bits and one outer bit replaces the bright flag; 76 CX, valid but above the 71-CX archive best.

Native three-product frame (per-site f_c, w_c; raw l_nv parity folded into site 0 as class bit; three real-phase Margolus Toffolis give y1..y3; collapse onto f_0) + flagless 18-term Walsh multiplexer R_X on f_0; 74 CX.

one partial flag F=[y0=y2=0] (1 rccx pair) + Walsh multiplexer over (u,v,e,F,y1,y3) with don't-cares, no full bright flag; walk = exact TSP over an 18-term MILP support (Gray-blocked walk model), first/last toggle merged into the ladder CX as CZ; 73 CX, 22 rotations k*beta/16, 25 qubits (does not beat the 71-CX seed).

parent frame (per-site cx, cx, rccx; class bit = raw l_nv parity folded into vp_0 = w0^p; flag a=[y0=y2=0]) with a 15-toggle walk: first toggle on e=q9 merged into the collapse CX as CZ (free), walk variables (e, pe, a, y1, y3) over a 13-term support (MILP support enumeration + Hamiltonian-path DP with free ends in span{e, v}); 71 CX, 10 rccx (T_fixed 40), 17 rotations, all angles k*beta/4 or 3*alpha/4.

parent's TCTT layout (site 1 swap-diagonal cx, cx, ch; Margolus transcoder on sites 0, 2, 3; flags a1=[y0=y2=0], A=[u=v=0]) with the walk re-optimised for toggle count: simulated annealing directly over toggle sequences (atoms e, v, u, w1=u^e, w3=v^e, A, a1, nv1, y3; link forms from the w slots) gives an 18-toggle closed walk with 15 rotations (MILP min on the visited sets, all k*beta/8), 72 CX instead of 80.

negative-result carrier for F3 round 2: the 71-CX transcoder + dimer-walk circuit (archive best, unchanged gate list) re-emitted in F3 after exhaustive searches found no cheaper gating in the transcoder frame; 71 CX, no gain.

Parent F4/001 (native three-product frame: f_c, w_c per site, raw l_nv parity folded into site 0, three real-phase Margolus Toffolis give y1..y3, collapse onto f_0, flagless 18-term Walsh multiplexer R_X on f_0) with the last walk toggle CX(w_1 -> f_0) replaced by its physical twin CX(g_1 -> f_0) on the collapse wire q3 and merged as CZ into the inverse collapse CX(0,3); 73 CX.

F5 restart from the seed core: per-site transcoder, ladder (u, v, e), flags a1=[y0=y2=0] (ancilla) and A=[u=v=0] XORed into y0, 13+1-toggle pivot walk with the last e-toggle merged into the inverse ladder; table-driven walk with free first/last CZ merges; 71 CX, 17 rotations k*beta/8 or 3*alpha/4 (ties the seed, does not beat it).

native 3-AND frame of r01-F3-001 (raw l_nv parity folded into site 0, Margolus Toffolis on sites 1-3 only, f-collapse; 46 CX, 24 fixed T, no flag ancilla) with its 17-term ungated Walsh multiplexer re-toured exactly: Held-Karp over the support with BFS distances in the Cayley graph of all single-wire forms (p, e, u, v, y1-y3, w1-w3, outer l_2v/l_v1 of site 0) and free ends in span{e, v}; the walk starts free on e (merged into the collapse CX as CZ) and needs 24 toggles instead of 30, 70 CX, all angles k*beta/4 or 3*alpha/4.

F1-002 frame and 15-toggle walk with an all-pivot-controlled ladder (cx(0,3), cx(0,6), cx(0,9): q3 = f0^f1 = w1 instead of u = f1^f3), so free walk ends lie anywhere in span{u, v, e}; same cost as the headline (71 CX, 10 rccx, 17 rotations), submitted as a structural variant, not an improvement.

F1-002 frame (per-site cx, cx, rccx; raw l_nv parity folded into vp_0 = w0^p; flag a=[y0=y2=0]) with an all-pivot-controlled ladder (free walk ends in span{u, v, e}) and the F1-002 13-term support re-toured by an Eulerian-trail MILP (edge multiplicities + single-commodity flow, free ends via a super node): 15 paid toggles from the free start e, 71 CX, 10 rccx, 17 rotations, all angles k*beta/4 or 3*alpha/4; no walk of <= 14 toggles was found, so this is a structural variant, not an improvement.

parent r03-F3-003 frame unchanged (raw l_nv parity folded into site 0, Margolus Toffolis on sites 1-3, f-collapse; 46 CX, 24 fixed T) with the Walsh support and its tour chosen jointly: simulated annealing directly over 22-toggle walks on the pivot (start free on e via the collapse-CX CZ merge, end at 0; exactness tested by least squares on all 51 labels of (p, y1, y2, y3, u, v, e, l_2v(0))) gives an 18-term support, all coefficients +-beta/4, that uses only p, y1-y3, e and the site-0 outer pair; 68 CX, all angles k*beta/4 or 3*alpha/4.

F1 recode-gate fusion probe: F3-style 46-CX frame (raw l_nv parity folded into site 0, three Margolus Toffolis) whose site-c Toffoli is controlled by f_D instead of f_c (D = (3, 0, 1)), so the labels become y_c xor w_c (f_c xor f_D) at no extra CX; SA walk of 30 toggles (free ends in span{u, v, e}), 24 walk rotations; 76 CX, a negative result versus the 68-CX headline.
